messages:
pagerbot: [AUTOPAGE] PagerDuty PD-82471 triggered for service="inference-gateway" region="eu-west1" — 5xx rate spike 7.4% (threshold 5%). Rule: http.errors.rate > 5% (5m). See https://pagerduty.example/PD-82471 :rotating_light:
alex: oncall here, acking PD-82471, taking lead. I'll start triage.
mia: looking at traces + dashboards now. spike lines up with a canary rollout started ~03:10 UTC. errors are mostly 502s from gateway -> model-pool timeouts.
devon: can anyone confirm whether model-pool scaleups are stalled? autoscaler not reporting new pods in last 5m.
chris: checking autoscaler: `kubectl -n inference get hpa model-pool` shows desired=12 current=8, cooldown seems stuck. also seeing a backlog on queue length metric `req_queue_len` jumping.
emily: heads-up: CustomerImpactSlack (cc: @support) — some customers reported timeouts in last 10m; not widespread but consistent. In case we need to notify, prepare a one-liner.
alex: plan: 1) favor immediate mitigation: increase pool target to 20, enable fallback-route to smaller model variant; 2) if that doesn't drop 5xx within 5m, failover region routing to eu-west2 for read-only traffic.
chris: executing step 1: `kubectl -n inference patch hpa model-pool --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/replicas","value":20}]'` — applying now.
devon: also enabling prefix KV warmup for the canary keys, `curl -X POST https://ops.example/api/kv/warmup -d '{"prefix":"/canary/", "parallel":10}'` to reduce cold-KV retries.
mia: quick note: traces show increased upstream retries from gateway -> model sidecar at ~50ms intervals, leads to retry amplification. Suggest we disable gateway retry policy for the canary route temporarily.
alex: disabling retries on canary route now. `routeset update --no-retry canary-route` — done.
pagerbot: PagerDuty: PD-82471 acknowledged by alex at 2924681378. Escalation timer paused.
chris: autoscaler responded, new replicas coming up (8 -> 16 observed), CPU still low but queue draining. 5xx rate down to 4.1% (1m agg). Good sign.
emily: customer impact update: support triage found ~12 tickets, all timeouts; advised to retry, no data loss. Preparing short status note: "We are mitigating a transient 5xx spike in eu-west1; routing and capacity changes in progress."
alex: handing off to devon for monitoring while I finish runbook notes. devon you're primary.
devon: ack, monitoring. I set an alert for 5xx > 3% sustained 3m. If it re-fires, I'll escalate to platform oncall and initiate routing failover.
oncall-bot: Reminder: next oncall rotation starts in 35m — consider transfer if this continues.
mia: postmortem note: root candidate = canary release causing increased KV cold-cache churn + gateway retry amplification. Will open a postmortem issue and link this thread.
pagerbot: PD-82471 status: resolved (auto-closed) at 2924682099 — 5xx rate below threshold for 10m. Please add follow-up tasks and mark lessons learned. :white_check_mark:
emily: thanks everyone. I'll send the customer update draft and start a support digest.
alex: great work. reminder: follow-up action items: 1) add retry guardrails to gateway, 2) improve autoscaler jitter/throttling to avoid stuck scale-ups, 3) automated KV warmup during canary rollouts. I'll add to the backlog.
